content.description:
Jackstraw features art from world-renowned artist Anthony Freda whose artwork is regularly published in prestigious outlets, such as such as Time, The New Yorker, Rolling Stone and The New York Times. Jackstraw Cardano NFT is a fully doxxed project, conceived from the mind of world-renowned artist, illustrator, curator and educator Anthony Freda.

Freda, an original member of NYC’s lowbrow art movement, brings a unique and artistically sophisticated viewpoint to Jackstraw that will set the stage for many NFT projects to come. His deeply symbolic artworks are collected worldwide and his illustrations are featured regularly in various prestigious publications. This is Freda’s premiere foray into the world of NFTs, ensuring Jackstraw’s collectibility.

Jackstraw NFT features 82 unique character traits guaranteeing absolute rarity and is slated for minting on February 18th (WL) and 19th (GP), 2023.
